"""Print what pylint's recursive discovery + expand_modules actually select."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/agent/work/work/pylint-7080-panel")

from pylint.lint.expand_modules import _is_ignored_file, expand_modules  # noqa: E402
from pylint.config.config_initialization import _config_initialization  # noqa: E402
from pylint.lint.pylinter import PyLinter  # noqa: E402

os.chdir("C:/Windows/Temp/repro7080b")

linter = PyLinter()
args = linter.load_command_line_config(["--recursive=y", "src/"])
print("ignore_paths config:", linter.config.ignore_paths)
print("recursive:", linter.config.recursive)

discovered = list(linter._discover_files(["src/"]))
print("\n_discover_files yielded:")
for f in discovered:
    print("  ", f)

print("\n_is_ignored_file per discovered path:")
for f in discovered:
    print("  ", f, "->", _is_ignored_file(
        f, linter.config.ignore, linter.config.ignore_patterns, linter.config.ignore_paths
    ))

result, errors = expand_modules(
    discovered,
    linter.config.ignore,
    linter.config.ignore_patterns,
    linter.config.ignore_paths,
)
print("\nexpand_modules result (modules that will be linted):")
for r in result:
    print("  ", r["path"], "isarg=", r["isarg"])
